title: Graduated Capability Stress Testing: At What Capability Level Does Debate Stop Being a Reliable Oversight Mechanism?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Knowing when debate breaks down as a function of capability gap is critical for extrapolating current safety results to future models. Directly informs the scalability of the most-studied oversight mechanism.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Debate experiments require implementing a debate protocol and running it across capability gaps. Using existing models of different sizes as debaters simplifies the setup. Medium compute sufficient for small-scale debate experiments.

narrow_scope.reasoning: One oversight mechanism (debate), one parameter sweep (capability gap). The deliverable (accuracy vs. capability gap curve) is clear. However, implementing debate with proper judging across multiple model pairs takes time. Achievable if limited to 3-4 gap levels.
